target_customer: CPA, audit and advisory firms, including Big Four and top 100 US firms
problem: Audit and advisory engagements run on emails, spreadsheets and disconnected tools, which hurts margins, quality and client experience.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription sold to accounting firms
product_category: Audit and advisory engagement workflow software, now agentic AI

founders.name: Jin Chang
prior_employers: EY (5 years in audit and advisory)
education: UC Berkeley, grad school (degree not named)
previous_startups: Cryptocurrency tax automation company founded in grad school (outcome not stated)

founders.name: Chris Szymansky
founders.background_notes: YC page and Pulse 2.0 name him co-founder and CTO. A profile reports the two met at Atrium, not opened. Surname also spelled Szymanski.

competitors.name: AuditBoard
competitors.what: Audit management, SOX, risk and compliance software
competitors.funding_then: 40M Series B led by Battery Ventures in August 2018

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow software with heavy integration and security requirements for audit firms; later agentic AI adds harder work.

defensibility.rationale: Engagement workflow embedded in firm methodology creates switching costs, but incumbents and other audit tools existed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents copying or buying Fieldguide; Fortune speculated in 2026 that an accounting firm acquisition could be a logical exit.

market_need_then: Founder Jin Chang had five years at EY and said he felt the pain of managing complex audit and advisory engagements; the profession faces an accountant shortage (Bloomberg coverage cited on the company blog, not opened).

branding.domain_note: Moved from fieldguide.io to fieldguide.com per YC listing (YC website field is fieldguide.com); date not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Practitioner credibility: built by former Big Four practitioners

branding.brand_signature: Product modules named Field Planner, Field Auditor, Field Reviewer

brand_strength.rationale: Established brand among accounting firms with NPS 84 claimed and trade press coverage, but no consumer or community signals.

outcome_analysis: Fieldguide is a standout of the batch: a practitioner founder built engagement workflow software for audit firms, raised a 17M Series A at 100M in 2022, 30M Series B in 2024 and 75M Series C at 700M in 2026, with 125M total reported. It sells to over half of the top 100 US accounting firms. Success came from founder market fit, an enterprise motion and the AI tailwind.
notes: Series A body says 17M with total 20M (headline says 20M); the roughly 3M before it is not itemized, so seed or pre-seed rounds are missing and coverage is partial. Series C total of 125M comes from search results of SiliconANGLE and CPA Practice Advisor. YC page also reports the Series A, Series C. No layoffs, shutdown or acquisition found.
